capabilities: Import a Zoho ZNote export ZIP into Markdown notes in a chosen folder
Convert checklists to Markdown tasks and HTML text to Markdown
Copy local card resources to asset folders and create embeds or links
Map notebook names and card fields to folders and YAML properties (Pro)
Compare a later export against a baseline import by card ID and SHA-256 (Pro)
disambiguation: Only handles Zoho's native ZNote export format; a Zoho HTML export is outside its scope.
extras: Freemium: core import is free; Pro (mapping profiles, later-export comparison) requires a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike. After updates, the plugin opens a 'What's new' tab that suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). Import limits: 64 MiB ZIP, 192 MiB expanded, 10,000 members. README lists untested areas (mobile, Windows/Linux, large archives, live payment). Reminders, location fields, and audio/sketch/encrypted cards are skipped.
problem: Obsidian's format converter cannot read Zoho Notebook's native ZNote archive format, so exporting cards into the vault otherwise requires manual conversion.

relations.evidence: The parser examples in zoho-notebook-to-obsidian helped identify the native fields.
The two sample ZIPs are from jimmy-test-data.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 one-time)

summary: Imports Zoho Notebook native ZNote export ZIPs as Markdown notes with YAML properties, tasks, tags, and local attachments, plus an import report.
